risks.description: AI responses may include unsupported claims

risks.contingency: Disable affected intent and route to agent

risks.mitigation: ACL-aware retrieval tests and source-level permissions
risks.contingency: Disable index and investigate access trail

risks.mitigation: Change requests scored by impact and steering approval

risks.description: Forecast delivery cost exceeds approved baseline
risks.mitigation: Monthly forecast, burn review and contingency gate

risks.description: Cloud or model provider outage interrupts service
risks.contingency: Degrade safely and route to agents

risks.description: Retrieval quality is insufficient for key intents
risks.mitigation: Build representative test set and tune chunking
Confirm sandbox contract and use adapter boundary
risks.contingency: Use controlled CSV handoff for UAT

risks.description: Temporary QA capacity is insufficient near UAT
risks.mitigation: Shift test design earlier and request approved support

risks.description: Support agents do not adopt the workflow

risks.mitigation: Entry criteria, risk-based testing and exit gates
risks.trigger: Critical open defect at UAT exit

risks.description: Document owners do not approve source corpus
risks.mitigation: Named approvers and staged content sign-off
Measure p95 latency and tune retrieval budget
risks.contingency: Reduce context and queue nonurgent work
